ape_winner_prompt_text: Express appropriate uncertainty. Overclaiming ("I'm 95% sure") on questions where you are actually 50–60% likely to be correct is a calibration failure. Be humble when humble is accurate. State your genuine confidence level, even if it is low. It is fine to say "Best guess: X. Confidence: 25%."
